mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE EMAIL = #{email}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS (ID, PW, EMAIL, ADDRESS, TEL, USER_NAME, USER_TYPE, USER_STATUS, CREATED_TIME, TOTAL_BALANCE, BID_DEPOSIT, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ID) VALUES (#{id}, #{pw}, #{email}, #{address}, #{tel}, #{userName}, #{userType}, COALESCE(#{userStatus}, 'ACTIVE'), SYSTIMESTAMP, COALESCE(#{totalBalance},0), COALESCE(#{bidDeposit},0), #{provider}, #{providerId})
